main_finding: Full-domain NRII is limited by the few-femtosecond charge-relaxation mode of the heavily doped contacts; direct O(N) block-Newton is faster in this 1D structured problem.
contact_condensation: Moves the coefficient radius outward but is only an approximate seed under the current freezing model.
relay: Restores full-system accuracy but is not faster than direct structured Newton in the current 1D benchmark.
